content.title: WWE WrestleMania 42 in Las Vegas Apr. 18-19, 2026 | Tickets and News
content.text: WrestleMania 42 is set to electrify Las Vegas once again! After a record-breaking, history-making event last year, WWE’s flagship spectacle returns to Allegiant Stadium for two epic nights on April 18 and 19, 2026. Tickets on sale now! Secure Your WrestleMania Las Vegas Experience Tickets: Official WWE Priority Pass Packages are now available from On Location, the Official Hospitality Provider of WWE. WrestleMania Priority Pass packages unlock the ultimate fan experience, including: Premium seating for both nights at Allegiant Stadium Unforgettable meet-and-greets and exclusive interactions with WWE Superstars Access to exclusive pre-show events and parties Unparalleled hospitality and VIP amenities throughout the weekend You Just Had To Be There! 📍 Relive WrestleMania 41 What to Expect at WrestleMania 42 Back-to-Back History: For the first time ever, WrestleMania will be held at the same venue two years in a row, following the most successful WrestleMania in WWE history with over 124,000 fans in attendance last year Double Down on Entertainment: Las Vegas is the entertainment capital of the world, offering world-class shows, nightlife, and attractions alongside the action-packed WrestleMania weekend Weekend of WWE Events: Beyond WrestleMania, enjoy SmackDown, the Hall of Fame Ceremony, NXT Stand & Deliver, and Raw After WrestleMania, all happening in the city If you’ve never been to Vegas, you may assume it’s a breeze to walk from one end of the Strip to the other. But who wants—or needs—to walk when there are so many options to get… If you’re headed to a game to watch the Silver and Black or are preparing for the concert of your life, Allegiant Stadium is near several fantastic Las Vegas resorts—both on the Strip and off. WrestleMania 42 Frequently Asked Questions When is WrestleMania 42? April 18 & 19, 2026, at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, NV. How can I buy WrestleMania 42 tickets? What other WWE events are happening? In addition to two nights of WrestleMania, WWE will bring Monday Night Raw, Friday Night SmackDown, Stand & Deliver and WWE World – a multi-day interactive fan experience What do official WrestleMania 42 Priority Passes include? Official WrestleMania 42 Priority Passes offers fans premium seating, hospitality events with Superstar appearances, exclusive photo opportunities, and more. Fans can place a deposit to secure access ahead of the general public. To learn more about WrestleMania 42 Priority Passes or to place a deposit, please visit: https://onlocationexp.com/wm42 Is there a minimum age for WrestleMania packages? No minimum age is required to purchase WrestleMania tickets or attend the event. However, a valid ID is necessary for collecting your Priority Pass credentials. How do I get to Allegiant Stadium? Many Las Vegas hotels are within walking distance to Allegiant Stadium. The Monorail, Deuce bus, and rideshares provide easy access for fans across the city
